metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said ‘You’re the chosen one’ and I just blinked
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get that without trying?
Enemy probably paused to check Discord.
Valorant logic handing out solo kills like candy.
Click if your aim’s mostly a happy accident!

Tap if your best kills come from pure luck!
